settings.notes: daily_calorie_goal and daily_protein_goal_g are optional — set them by telling Claude e.g. 'set my daily calorie goal to 2200' or 'set my protein goal to 160'. protein_goal was set using a bodyweight-based heuristic (0.8-1g per lb) for lifting-while-in-a-deficit, at ~189lb — recalculate if bodyweight changes meaningfully. timezone controls how dates/times are stamped on entries — tell Claude your timezone to set it once.

recipes.name: Sausage Egg Casserole
recipes.notes: Whole casserole ~2,502 cal / ~163.5g protein total, cut into 16 equal squares. Per square also ~11-12g fat, ~2g carbs. If Deano mentions any deviation when logging (fewer/more squares, an omitted or swapped ingredient, a half batch, etc.), recompute from the ingredients list above instead of using the cached per-unit numbers, then log the recomputed total. Only overwrite ingredients/calories_per_unit here if he says the change is permanent to the recipe itself.

recipes.name: Trader Joe's Teeny Tiny Avocado
recipes.notes: ~11g fat, ~6g carbs, ~5g fiber per whole avocado. Fractional amounts (e.g. 'half a tiny avocado') scale linearly: half = 60 cal / 0.75g protein.
